selector.exclude: markets whose question contains 'Up or Down'
selector.exclude_mm: buys both tokens of a market within 1h in >=10% of its markets
selector.rank: market-clustered t of copy returns (entry +max(1c,2%) + fee; exit = wallet's first sell -max(1c,2%) - fee, else 0/1 resolution), exits known before the ranking cut-off only, mean>0

simulator: 100 USD, stake max(4, 5 shares), cash recycled at each exit, 1 position per market, <=15 USD open per wallet, unresolved positions marked at cost
pass_rule: P3 clustered mean>0 with t>2.5 AND simulated account final>100; then P4 forward must also be positive before any live paper session
disclosures: P3 (2026-08-26..) was already looked at by entry-price bucket in Phase 16; this hypothesis was motivated by that look, so P3 is not fully clean. P4 (after freeze) is the clean test.
Activity is capped at 3000 trades per wallet per cached window (newest first): heavy traders have truncated histories.
Validation failed for every K before freezing; K=25 is the Phase 16 default, not chosen on validation.
